title: Weil $!$-pushforward along a separated morphism
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum and the coefficient ring
$A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated morphism of
separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, with geometric base change
$f:X\to Y$, and write $\Phi_X,\Phi_Y$ for the $q$-power scheme
Frobenii of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. Use the finite-coefficient
operations and comparisons of [sk-d-six], realized here by
[prop-functor-package]; scheme and morphism terminology is that of
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $m\geq1$ use the
relative Frobenius factorization of [d-relative-frob]:

$$
X'_m=Y\times_{\Phi_Y^m,Y,f}X,\qquad
p_m:X'_m\to X,\quad f'_m:X'_m\to Y,\qquad
r_m=(f,\Phi_X^m):X\to X'_m,
$$

so that $p_mr_m=\Phi_X^m$ and $f'_mr_m=f$; this uses
$f\Phi_X^m=\Phi_Y^mf$, which holds because $\Phi^m$ is the base
change of the $q^m$-power Frobenius of $k_0$-schemes, which commutes
with every $k_0$-morphism.

1. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ the *Frobenius comparison*
$\theta_{f,m}=\theta_{f,m,K}$ is the composite
$$
L\Phi_Y^{m*}Rf_!K
\xrightarrow[\sim]{\operatorname{Ex}_!}Rf'_{m!}Lp_m^*K
\xrightarrow{Rf'_{m!}(\eta_{r_m})}
Rf'_{m!}Rr_{m*}Lr_m^*Lp_m^*K
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rf_!L\Phi_X^{m*}K .
$$
The first arrow is the compact-support exchange of
[def-exchange-projection] for the Cartesian square defining $X'_m$,
an isomorphism by arbitrary base change ([prop-functor-package],
clause (4)). The second arrow is $Rf'_{m!}$ applied to the unit of
$Lr_m^*\dashv Rr_{m*}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations],
whose finite-coefficient direct image is [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. The last
arrow is $Rr_{m*}\simeq Rr_{m!}$ for the finite, hence proper
([lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper]), map $r_m$, the composition law
$Rf'_{m!}Rr_{m!}\simeq R(f'_mr_m)_!=Rf_!$ ([prop-functor-package],
clause (3)), and $Lr_m^*Lp_m^*\simeq L(p_mr_m)^*=L\Phi_X^{m*}$
([lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]), using the
finite-coefficient pullbacks of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
The middle unit is invertible: $r_m$ is a finite universal
homeomorphism by [i-relative-frob], so $Lr_m^*$ is an equivalence
on $D^b_{ctf}$ with invertible unit by [i-topology], applied to
$Lp_m^*K\in D^b_{ctf}(X'_m,A)$ by
[thm-sf-ctf-stability], clause (i). Hence $\theta_{f,m}$ is an
isomorphism. It is natural in $K$: the compact-support exchange of [def-exchange-projection] is a
composite of natural transformations on the ambient finite-coefficient
categories. For an arrow $v:K\to K'$, write $a,b,c$ for the three
arrows defining $\theta$, and $F_0,F_1,F_2,F_3$ for their respective
source, intermediate, and target functors. Naturality of the
exchange gives $a_{K'}F_0(v)=F_1(v)a_K$, naturality of the
adjunction unit gives $b_{K'}F_1(v)=F_2(v)b_K$, and naturality
of the proper, pushforward-composition, and pullback-composition
comparisons gives $c_{K'}F_2(v)=F_3(v)c_K$. Thus
$\theta_{K'}F_0(v)=c_{K'}b_{K'}a_{K'}F_0(v)
=F_3(v)c_Kb_Ka_K=F_3(v)\theta_K$.
1. For a Frobenius coefficient morphism $u:L\Phi_X^*K\to K$ of
[def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism] (no invertibility
assumed), the *Weil $!$-pushforward* of $(K,u)$ along $f$ is the
pair $(Rf_!K,\psi)$ with
$$
\psi=Rf_!u\circ\theta_{f,1}:\;
L\Phi_Y^*Rf_!K\xrightarrow{\ \theta_{f,1}\ }Rf_!L\Phi_X^*K
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_!u\ }Rf_!K .
$$
It lies in $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ by [thm-sf-ctf-stability], clause (iv),
and $\psi$
is a Frobenius coefficient morphism on $Rf_!K$.
1. In particular, for a strict Weil complex $(K,\varphi)$ of
[def-trf-strict-weil-complex], take $u=u_1=\varphi\circ\kappa_K$,
its scheme-Frobenius map of [def-trf-iterated-weil-map], with
$\kappa$ of [prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison]. Then $\psi$ is a
composite of two isomorphisms, so $(Rf_!K,\psi)$ is a pushforward
with invertible scheme-Frobenius structure.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q86-a34b97cbb (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the delivery in full. The statement is the main-20261015 text of def-trf-weil-shriek-pushforward (order 2708; identical to master order 2364 except the order line), with citation and typing repairs only. The adjunction unit is now cited from def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations and pullback composition from lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition. Rf_! preserving D^b_ctf is cited from thm-sf-ctf-stability (iv), and Lp_m^*K in D^b_ctf from clause (i). The appeal to fix-lem-exchanges is replaced by an explicit naturality calculation. That replacement is justified: fix-lem-exchanges types Ex_! at A_{E,n} only on étale-origin witnessed complexes, while def-exchange-projection's Ex_!^c is a composite of natural transformations on all of D(-_proet,A). No hypothesis or conclusion changed. Clause 1 checks: Φ_Y^m is a finite k-morphism, so the hypotheses of def-exchange-projection hold. Ex_! runs Lg^*Rf_! -> Rf'_!Lg'^* with g'=p_m, and it is invertible by prop-functor-package (4), the blueprint's own citation. The unit is taken at Lp_m^*K on X'_m. i-relative-frob gives r_m finite and a universal homeomorphism, and i-topology gives the invertible unit on D^b_ctf. X'_m = X_0^{(Q)} x k (d-relative-frob), so it lies in the coefficient conventions. Clauses 2 and 3 check: u is arbitrary as in def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism. u_1 = φ∘κ_K, with κ: LΦ^* -> Lg_γ^* in both the DAG node and its blueprint_update, so ψ is invertible. Small cases: f=id and f=a_X (where Φ on Spec k is the identity, so θ is the standard Frobenius map on RΓ_c), proper f, K=0, u=0; m=0 is excluded. There are no new nodes and no duplicates (lem-fix-weil-operations covers rational coefficients and points to this item), no cycle, all 18 cited ids exist and are unmerged, and the unit change is only realized/realized_by. No tool_uses and no SGA.
